content:

Real Madrid enters the tie in stellar form, driven by the sensational performances of their star-studded midfield and attack. However, visiting the Benito Villamarín is historically one of the toughest road trips in Spanish football. Real Betis has proven to be a resilient force under Pellegrini, combining disciplined defensive structures with rapid transitional play.

For Carlo Ancelotti’s side, maintaining tactical discipline in transition will be paramount. With several key players returning from the treatment room, the Italian tactician faces welcome selection dilemmas, particularly in the midfield engine room where competition for starting spots remains fierce.

"Playing against Betis in Seville is always an intense challenge. They are well-organized, passionate, and possess individual quality that can punish any mistake. We must be flawless defensively to secure all three points."

Betis vs Real Madrid: Key Questions Answered

What time does the Real Betis vs Real Madrid match kick off?

Where can I watch the live stream of Betis vs Real Madrid?
